1.explanation: Because we have registered a global or story-level FeatureFlags decorator, Storybook’s docs addon picks up the decorator wrapper as the source of the story. It cannot infer the actual “Notification” component call, so it prints the JSX for the decorator (<FeatureFlags> …) and shows <No Display Name /> for the wrapped story. This minimal setup reproduces exactly what you see in carbon-components-react v1.4.0’s Notification MDX: the “Show code” panel displays only the FeatureFlags layer and no real component call.
1.bug_scenario: When viewing the Notification component in Storybook’s “Docs” tab (e.g. the Inline example under Notifications), clicking the “Show code” button doesn’t render the actual Notification JSX. Instead, the code panel shows only the FeatureFlags wrapper and a placeholder (<No Display Name />), as if the story itself has no display name.
